references.source: Economics and Statistics Office. The Cayman Islands’ Compendium of Statistics 2022. George Town, July 2023
references.notes: Based on the data, it was identified that for 2022, 2,701 tons went to recycling (p. 187), 145,590 tons were sent to landfill (p. 186), and 407 tons went to incineration (p. 186). These values were summed, and the percentages of each were calculated.
